name: Webhook Incident Intake
description: Accept an incident payload, normalize fields, and return an acknowledgement.
retries: No external calls in the reference workflow; add exponential backoff when integrations are introduced.
error_handling: Webhook validation failures return a controlled response; production variants should attach an error workflow.
idempotency: Reference workflow is side-effect free. Production variants must derive an idempotency key from incident_id.
observability: Track execution id, incident id, duration, and failure count.
